messages:
asha: Quick sync: we need a short playbook for handling internal proto vs HTTP at the edge. Key: route identity, quota attribution, and a clear canary path.

mike: I'm for proto-first inside the mesh. Gateway should transcode for public HTTP clients but must not obscure the canonical method used for billing/alerts.

ella: Billing request: every request needs a stable canonical key. header idea: `x-canonical-key: inference.v1.ModelService.Generate#v1`. Use that for cost buckets.

tess: Console needs to surface both views: canonical (for cost/SLAs) and observed (for client debugging). add a small badge when gateway performed transcode.

devex: Rollout pattern: opt-in tenants -> small percent -> verification gates -> ramp. Add feature flags to flip transport per-tenant.

opsbot: Canary started 2026-04-12T09:30:00Z for group proto-spike-4.

mike: Gateway contract (minimal): always emit `x-canonical-key`, `x-proto-sha`, `x-transport-observed` and if any fields were dropped set `x-transcode-status=partial`. If fallback to passthrough, set `x-transcode-fallback=true`.

ella: Quota flow: gateway does pre-check and stamps `x-quota-check-id`. On limit return stable JSON: `{"error":"quota_exceeded","quota":"tokens","remaining":0,"retry_after":30}` so SDKs handle consistently.

tess: Streaming note: gRPC bidi is unsupported over plain HTTP. Server-streams -> SSE with documented semantics; client-streaming -> not supported, return 501.

mike: Observability: gateway should emit a small event with fields: canonical_key, observed_transport, transcode_latency_ms, transcode_status. We'll build a dashboard for spike.

devex: Canary gates: transcode-fallback rate <0.1%, 5xx delta <5%, median latency change <3ms. Auto rollback if breached.

asha: Action items: mike -> sidecar prototype; tess -> console dual-view mock; ella -> header & quota spec; devex -> canary playbook. Sync Fri 11am.

taskbot: Created task INF-1699: proto-first edge playbook -> assignees: mike, tess, ella, devex

mike: starting spike Monday. will post a tiny smoke PR.

tess: mockup Thursday.

asha: Thanks everyone, short updates only in this thread until spike complete.
